elementi.titolo: A Russian FSB officer accused by Ukraine of trying to assassinate Kyrylo Budanov is attending peace talks in Abu Dhabi. His alleged target is there, too — as part of Ukraine’s delegation.
elementi.sommario: The Russian delegation at the trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi has five members and six experts. Four of them are taking part in these talks for the first time, the independent Russian investigative outlet Agentstvo said.
